units.en: His brother Kuangming, styled Zanyao, entered office young as a literary officer at Jiangling through their father's rank.
units.literal: Kuangning's younger brother Kuangming, style name Zanyao, in youth by his father's eminence entered office as a single son—he was Jiangling prefecture literary officer.

units.zh: 蔡州人也。
units.en: was a native of Cai prefecture.
units.literal: was a man of Cai prefecture.

units.zh: 匡凝氣貌甚偉，好自修飾，每整衣冠，必使人持巨鑒前後照之。
units.en: Tall and vain, he had great mirrors held before and behind him whenever he dressed.
units.literal: Kuangning's bearing was very grand; he loved self-adornment—each time he arranged cap and robes he must have men hold great mirrors before and behind to shine on him.

units.zh: 對客之際，烏巾上微覺有塵，即令侍妓持紅拂以去之。
units.en: If he sensed dust on his black cap before guests, maids brushed it away with red dusters.
units.literal: When facing guests, on the black cap he slightly sensed dust and at once ordered serving girls to hold red dusters to remove it.

units.zh: 八月，太祖親領大軍南征，仍請削匡凝在身官爵。
units.en: Month 8 the Founder marched south in person and had Kuangning stripped of rank.
units.literal: Eighth month, the Founder personally led a great army south on campaign and still requested stripping Kuangning of his personal offices and titles.

units.zh: 《歐陽史》云：行密厚遇匡凝，其後行密死，楊渥稍不禮之。
units.en: Ouyang's 《History》 says Xingmi treated Kuangning well, but after Xingmi's death Yang Wo grew rude to him.
units.literal: The 《History of Ouyang》 says: Xingmi treated Kuangning generously; afterward Xingmi died and Yang Wo gradually was without courtesy to him.

units.zh: 諸將以為慢，渥遣匡凝海陵，後為徐溫所殺。）〉
units.en: Officers took it as insult; Wo exiled him to Hailing, where Xu Wen later killed him.)〉
units.literal: The generals thought it disrespect; Wo sent Kuangning to Hailing and later Xu Wen killed him.)〉

units.zh: 初，匡凝好聚書，及敗，楊師厚獲數千卷於第，悉以來獻。
units.en: Kuangning had loved books; after his defeat Shihou seized thousands of scrolls from his house and presented them to the Founder.
units.literal: At first Kuangning loved gathering books; when defeated, Yang Shihou obtained several thousand scrolls at his residence and entirely brought them as tribute.

units.zh: 匡凝對使者流涕，答以受國恩深，豈敢隨時妄有他誌。
units.en: Kuangning wept before the envoy and said the state's grace was too deep for him to change sides with the times.
units.literal: Kuangning to the envoy wept and replied that the state's grace was deep—how dare he follow the times and rashly have another intent.

units.zh: 渥方宴食青梅，匡凝顧渥曰：「勿多食，發小兒熱。」
units.en: At a feast Wo ate green plums; Kuangning warned, "Do not eat too many—they bring fever in children."
units.literal: Wo was just feasting and eating green plums; Kuangning looked at Wo and said: "Do not eat much—it brings children's fever."

units.zh: 光化初，匡凝以太祖有清口之敗，密附於淮夷，太祖遣氏叔琮率師伐之。
units.en: Early in Guanghua, after the Founder's defeat at Qingkou, Kuangning secretly sided with the Huai rebels and the Founder sent Shi Shucong against him.
units.literal: At the start of Guanghua, because the Founder had been defeated at Qingkou, Kuangning secretly attached himself to the Huai forces; the Founder sent Shi Shucong with troops to attack him.

units.zh: 俄而康懷英攻下鄧州，匡凝懼，遣使乞盟，太祖許之，自是附庸於太祖。
units.en: Kang Huaiying took Deng; Kuangning sued for peace, the Founder agreed, and he became a vassal.
units.literal: Soon Kang Huaiying attacked and took Deng prefecture; Kuangning feared and sent envoys to beg alliance—the Founder permitted it; from then he was a vassal of the Founder.

units.zh: 是時唐室微弱，諸道常賦多不上供，惟匡凝昆仲雖強據江山，然盡忠帝室，貢賦不絕。
units.en: While Tang weakened and most circuits withheld tribute, the Zhao brothers still sent loyal levies from their strongholds.
units.literal: At that time the Tang house was weak; many circuits' regular levies often did not go up in tribute—only Kuangning and his brothers, though strongly holding rivers and mountains, yet were wholly loyal to the imperial house and tribute and levies did not cease.

units.zh: 太祖將期受禪，以匡凝兄弟並據藩鎮，乃遣使先諭旨焉。
units.en: As the Founder prepared to take the throne, he sent envoys ahead to the Zhao brothers holding the frontier commands.
units.literal: The Founder was about to fix the date to receive the abdication mandate; because Kuangning and his brothers both held frontier commissions, he sent envoys first to announce the intent.

units.zh: 及師厚濟江，匡凝以兵數萬逆戰，大為師厚所敗，匡凝乃燔其舟，單舸急棹，沿漢而遁於金陵。
units.en: Shihou crossed the river; Kuangning met him with tens of thousands, was routed, burned his fleet, and fled alone up the Han to Jinling.
units.literal: When Shihou crossed the river, Kuangning with tens of thousands of troops met him in battle and was greatly defeated by Shihou; Kuangning then burned his boats, in a single skiff urgently rowed, and along the Han fled to Jinling.

units.zh: 〈（《新唐書》云：師厚由陰穀伐木為梁，匡凝以兵二萬瀕江戰，大敗，乃燔州，單舸夜奔揚州。
units.en: (The 《New Book of Tang》 says Shihou bridged Yin Valley, Kuangning lost twenty thousand along the river, burned the prefecture, and fled by night to Yangzhou.
units.literal: (The 《New Book of Tang》 says: Shihou by Yin Valley felled timber for beams; Kuangning with twenty thousand troops fought along the river, was greatly defeated, then burned the prefecture and in a single skiff fled by night to Yangzhou.

units.zh: 乾寧二年，建與鳳翔李茂貞、邠州王行瑜舉兵赴闕，迫昭宗請以王珙為河中帥，害大臣於都下。
units.en: In Qianning 2 Jian joined Li Maozhen of Fengxiang and Wang Xingyu of Binzhou in marching troops to the capital. They pressured Emperor Zhaozong to appoint Wang Gong military governor of Hezhong and killed senior ministers in the capital.
units.literal: In Qianning year 2 Jian with Fengxiang's Li Maozhen and Binzhou's Wang Xingyu raised troops to the capital, forced Zhaozong to make Wang Gong Hezhong commander, and killed great ministers in the capital.

units.zh: 偽六軍使王宗弼報，王衍舉家遷於西宅，宗弼權稱西川兵馬留後；
units.en: The Shu Six Armies commissioner Wang Zongbi reported that Wang Yan had moved his household to the western residence and Zongbi styled himself acting western Shu army retention commissioner;
units.literal: The Shu Six Armies commissioner Wang Zongbi reported that Wang Yan had moved his whole household to the western residence and Zongbi provisionally styled himself western Shu army-and-horse retention commissioner;

units.zh: 〈（《九國誌·王宗弼傳》：唐師陷鳳州，衍遣三招討屯三泉以拒唐師，未戰，三招討俱遁走，因令宗弼守綿穀而誅三招討，宗弼遂與三招討同送款於魏王。
units.en: (The 《Nine States Institutes · Wang Zongbi》 says when Tang took Feng, Yan sent three campaign commanders to Sanquan; before battle all three fled; Yan ordered Zongbi to hold Mian Valley and killed the three commanders; Zongbi then with them submitted to the Prince of Wei.
units.literal: (The 《Nine States Institutes · Wang Zongbi Biography》: when Tang troops took Fengzhou, Yan dispatched the three campaign commanders to camp at Sanquan to resist Tang; before battle all three campaign commanders fled; he then ordered Zongbi to hold Mian Valley and executed the three campaign commanders; Zongbi thereupon with the three campaign commanders together sent allegiance to the Prince of Wei.

units.zh: 十一月庚寅朔，帝幸壽安，號慟於坤陵。
units.en: On the gengyin new moon of the eleventh month Cunxu visited Shou'an and wailed at Kun Mausoleum.
units.literal: Eleventh month, gengyin new moon: the Emperor visited Shou'an and wailed at Kun Mausoleum.

units.zh: 又報偽樞密使宋光嗣景潤澄、宣徽使李周輅歐陽晃同有異謀，惑亂蜀主，已梟斬訖。
units.en: he also reported that Shu privy commissioners Song Guangsi and Jing Runcheng, and Xuanhui commissioners Li Zhoulu and Ouyang Huang, alike had plotted, confused the Shu ruler, and had already been beheaded and displayed.
units.literal: he also reported that Shu privy commissioners Song Guangsi and Jing Runcheng, and Xuanhui commissioners Li Zhoulu and Ouyang Huang, alike harbored divergent plots, confused the Shu ruler, and had already been beheaded and displayed.

units.zh: 乃還成都，斬宋光嗣等，函首送於魏王，遷衍及母妻於西宮。）〉
units.en: He returned to Chengdu, killed Song Guangsi and the rest, sent their heads to the Prince of Wei, and moved Yan, his mother, and his wife to the western palace.)〉
units.literal: He then returned to Chengdu, beheaded Song Guangsi and the rest, sent their heads in boxes to the Prince of Wei, and moved Yan and his mother and wife to the western palace.)〉

units.zh: 甲戌，唐帝引師襲中都，王彥章兵潰，於是彥章與監軍張漢傑及趙廷隱、劉嗣彬、李知節、唐文通、王山興等皆為唐人所獲。
units.en: On jiaxu the Tang emperor stormed Zhongdu; Yanzhang’s army broke; he, Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, and others were taken.
units.literal: On jiaxu the Tang Emperor led troops to strike Zhongdu; Wang Yanzhang’s army collapsed; thereupon Yanzhang, army supervisor Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, Liu Sibin, Li Zhijie, Tang Wentong, Wang Shanxing, and others were all captured by Tang men.

units.zh: 後劉備稱天子於蜀，皆如扶言。
units.en: When Liu Bei later declared himself emperor in Shu, every word of Fu's prophecy had come true.
units.literal: Later Liu Bei declared himself Son of Heaven in Shu; everything was as Fu had said.

units.zh: 元行欽請車駕幸汴州，帝將發京師，遣中官向延嗣馳詔所在誅蜀主王衍，仍夷其族。
units.en: Yuan Xingqin asked Cunxu to go to Bian; as he was about to leave the capital he sent Xiang Yansi with a flying edict to execute Wang Yan and exterminate his clan.
units.literal: Yuan Xingqin asked that the imperial carriage go to Bianzhou; the Emperor was about to set out from the capital and sent a palace official, Xiang Yansi, with a flying edict to the place to execute Shu ruler Wang Yan and still exterminate his clan.

units.zh: 〈（《九國誌·李仁罕傳》：夏魯奇稟朝廷之命，繕治甲兵，將圖蜀，孟知祥與董璋謀先取魯奇，令仁罕攻遂州。）〉
units.en: (From the Biography of Li Renhan in the Jiuguo Zhi: Xia Luqi obeyed the court's orders, repaired arms and armor, and prepared to move against Shu. Meng Zhixiang and Dong Zhang plotted to strike him first and ordered Renhan to attack Suizhou.)〉
units.literal: (From the Biography of Li Renhan in the Jiuguo Zhi: Xia Luqi received the court's orders, repaired armor and weapons, and planned to strike Shu; Meng Zhixiang and Dong Zhang plotted first to take Luqi and ordered Renhan to attack Suizhou.)〉

units.zh: 時興元楊守亮將襲京師，道出金、商，行襲逆擊，大破之。
units.en: He crushed Yang Shouliang marching on the capital through Jin and Shang.
units.literal: At that time Xingyuan's Yang Shouliang was about to strike the capital; the road passed Jin and Shang; Xingxi met and struck, greatly defeating him.

units.zh: 宦官王承休居中用事，與成都尹韓昭內外相結，專采擇聲色，以固寵幸。
units.en: The eunuch Wang Chengxiu dominated the court, conspiring with the Chengdu prefect Han Zhao to stock the palace with entertainers and secure their hold on the emperor's favor.
units.literal: The eunuch Wang Chengxiu held power at court and, with the Chengdu prefect Han Zhao linking inside and outside, devoted themselves solely to gathering music and beauty to secure favor.

units.zh: 歲餘，承休欲求旄鉞，乃以隴西花木入獻，又稱秦州山水之美，人物之盛，請後主臨幸，而韓昭讚成之。
units.en: After a year Chengxiu wanted a full military commission; he sent Longxi flowers and trees as tribute, praised Qinzhou's scenery and beauties, and asked the emperor to visit in person, with Han Zhao seconding the plan.
units.literal: After more than a year Chengxiu wished to obtain the commander's baton and axe; he therefore presented flowers and trees of Longxi as tribute, and again praised the beauty of Qinzhou's mountains and waters and the abundance of its people, requesting that the Later Lord visit in person, while Han Zhao urged it on.
